blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dexterous multi-finger hands hold promise to unlock diverse skills like functional grasps, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic handover that the human-designed world assumes, yet existing learning recipes force a trade-off. Goal-reaching reinforcement learning generalizes to arbitrary object poses but, lacking any human prior, converges to unnatural and unreliable finger strategies; motion tracking reproduces human-like behavior from a single clip but cannot deviate from it. We present AdaDex, a goal-conditioned RL framework that turns a single hand-object trajectory of a few seconds---from mocap data or HOI reconstruction from in-the-wild RGB(D) video---into an adaptable dexterous skill. At the core of AdaDex is Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking: a shared policy is trained on two populations of massively parallel environments: motion tracking environments trained with dense motion tracking objective, which instill the human prior from human motion; and generalization environments with noised initial states and goals and a sparse object-success reward, which force the skill to work far off the reference. From seconds of human motion per skill, the resulting policies can learn diverse adaptable dexterous skills, such as functional grasping, object reposing, in-hand reorientation with finger gaiting, and dynamic behaviors like throw-and-catch. Our method outperforms baselines in terms of generalization and functionality, and we demonstrate transfer across simulators and to the real world. Project page: https://yuxuank.com/AdaDex/.
blocks.zh: Dexters的多指手可及地解锁各种技能,如功能把握,手可及的重定向,以及人类设计的世界所假设的动态交接,然而现有的学习食谱却迫使取舍. 目标深远的强化学习一般化为任意物体的姿势,但缺乏任何人类前身,会与不自然和不可靠的手指策略汇合;运动跟踪从一个片段复制出类似人类的行为,但不能偏离它. 我们提出AdaDex,一个有目标条件的RL框架,它将一个几秒钟的单手对象轨迹——从Mocap数据或HOI重建从闪烁的RGB(D)视频——变成一个可适应的dexterous技能. AdaDex的核心是Hybrid Dexterous Micking:一项共同政策是针对两个具有大规模平行环境的人群而培训的:运动跟踪环境训练有密集运动跟踪目标,它使人类先于运动;以及泛化环境,其初始状态和目标被点名,对象成功奖励很少,这迫使技能远远偏离参考。 从每个技能的人类运动秒起,由此产生的政策可以学习各种适应性强的巧妙技能,例如功能把握,物体重置,用手指步态进行手动方向调整,以及像投掷和捕获这样的动态行为. 我们的方法在概括和功能方面超过了基线,我们展示了跨模拟器和向现实世界的转移。 项目网页:https://yuxuank.com/AdaDex/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Our built environment is designed around the human hand: tools, handles, lids, and switches all presuppose a multi-fingered end-effector.
Many of the skills this design affords, including functional tool use, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic behaviors such as throwing and catching, remain difficult for parallel-jaw grippers, which makes dexterous hands a natural embodiment for general-purpose manipulation.
Despite this promise, learning dexterous skills is challenging.
A multi-fingered hand must act in a high-dimensional continuous action space with 20+ degrees of freedom, and each skill must regulate contact forces, friction, and gravity across many simultaneous and often intermittent contacts under fast dynamics.
blocks.zh:
我们建造的环境是围绕着人类的手设计的:工具、手柄、盖子和开关都预先假定一个多指端效应器。
这种设计所提供的许多技能,包括功能工具的使用,手头的重定向,以及抛出和接取等动态行为,对于平行的抓取者来说仍然很困难,这让德克西特手成为了通用操纵的自然化的化身.
尽管有这一承诺,但学习狡猾的技能仍具有挑战性。
多指手必须在具有20+自由度的高维连续行动空间中行动,而每种技能必须调节接触力,摩擦力和重力,在快速动态下跨越许多同时并时常间断的接触.

blocks.en:
Two paradigms currently dominate learning-based dexterous manipulation, and they fail in complementary ways. Consider picking up a hammer lying on a table and striking a nail. Goal-reaching reinforcement learning ( Kuang et al., 2026 ; Kedia et al., 2026 ) trains a single policy to move an object from any initial pose to any target pose, achieving broad coverage. Given target hammer poses, such a policy can bring the hammer to the nail. However, an object-centric reward specifies only where the object should end up, not how to get it there. Without explicit shaping, the policy could seize the hammer by its head or pinch it mid-shaft. These grasps might satisfy the goal but are not functional for hammering.
Additionally, behaviors that require finger gaiting or regrasping, such as reorienting the hammer in hand from a lying-flat pickup to a striking grip with functional thumb bracing, are rarely discovered at all. As a result, the intricate motion the task demands remain largely out of reach. Motion tracking ( Li et al., 2025 ; Mandi et al., 2025 ) , in contrast, imitates a hand-object trajectory under dense supervision and thereby inherits the demonstrator’s functional grasp, in-hand regrasp, and swing. The resulting policy, however, is bound to the reference. If the nail sits at a different location or angle, the policy has no mechanism to adapt, and it typically requires the dense reference as input at inference time. In short, tracking supplies the human prior and goal reaching supplies generalization, but neither alone yields a skill that is both human-like and adaptable.
blocks.zh:
两种范式目前主导了以学习为主的有弹性的操纵,它们以互补的方式失败了. 考虑拿起锤子躺在桌子上并打出指甲来. 目标深远的强化学习(Kuang等,2026;Kedia等,2026)训练出单一政策,将物体从任何初始姿势移动到任何目标姿势,实现广泛的覆盖. 鉴于目标锤子的姿势,这样的政策可以将锤子带到指甲上. 然而,以物体为中心的奖励只规定物体应在何地结束,而不是如何到达. 如果没有明确的塑造,政策就可能用头来抓锤子,或把它捏到中间。 这些抓取可以满足目标,但不能用来敲锤子。
此外,那些需要指步或取回重力的行为,例如将手中的锤子从放屁的皮克调整到用功能性的拇指刹车的惊人握住,都很少被发现. 因此,任务要求的复杂动议在很大程度上仍然无法达到。 相形之下,运动跟踪(Li等,2025;Mandi等,2025)在密集的监督下模仿了手取物轨迹,从而继承了演示人的功能把握,手取重力和摇摆. 然而,由此产生的政策必须参照参考。 如果指甲坐落于不同的位置或角度,则政策没有适应机制,通常在推断时间需要密集的参考作为输入. 简言之,跟踪为人类提供了先入为主和达到目标的供给,但单靠跟踪并不能产生一种既像人类又适应性强的技能。

blocks.en: To that end, we present AdaDex , which treats the two paradigms as complements rather than alternatives. At the core of AdaDex is Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking , built on the observation that motion tracking and goal reaching are the same goal-conditioned problem: both ask a policy π θ ​ ( a ∣ s , g ) \pi_{\theta}(a\mid s,g) to bring the object and wrist to a target pose g g , and differ only in where g g comes from and how progress is rewarded. We therefore train one policy across two kinds of massively parallel environments: Tracking Environments (TrackEnv) initialize along a human hand-object reference τ ^ \hat{\tau} , take goals from τ ^ \hat{\tau} , and apply a dense tracking reward on object, wrist, fingers, and contacts, teaching the policy how a human grasps, gaits, and releases. Generalization Environments (GenEnv) perturb the initialization with large noise, offset the goal by a random SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) transformation that can be far from any frame of τ ^ \hat{\tau} , and reward only sparse object success plus wrist guidance, with no finger terms. The two are mutually reinforcing. TrackEnv supplies the prior and the exploration: skills that sparse reward almost never discovers, such as throwing an object and catching it mid-flight, are learned under dense tracking and, because g g is the only channel of task information, become directly addressable by novel goals. GenEnv supplies the generalization: it forces success from off-reference states toward off-reference goals so the skill can be adaptable to new scenarios and does not collapse into replaying one clip, while leaving the finger strategy to the human prior. Neither suffices alone; together they yield a skill that is both functional and adaptable. The recipe needs no discriminator, phase variable, or distillation stage, and the dense reference is not required at test time: at deployment the policy consumes only proprioception, object pose, object shape, and a goal pose, so it can be driven by any goal source, such as VLM Agent planner’s output waypoints.

blocks.en: We evaluate AdaDex on functional grasping of diverse tools and household objects, in-hand reorientation requiring finger gaiting and contact switching, and dynamic behaviors like throw-and-catch. Every skill is learned from a single human motion trajectory of a few seconds. The learned policies preserve the grasp type, in-hand manipulation, and dynamic behaviors from human motion, while generalizing to unseen trajectories and randomized object goals far from the reference, and achieve various downstream tasks with VLM Agents under multiple embodiments. Additionally, we demonstrate that our recipe can be embedded in between real-to-sim and sim-to-real, where a few seconds of human motion from in-the-wild RGB(D) videos is converted into a simulation-ready hand-object reference via our advanced HOI reconstruction pipeline. And then the reference is broadened into an adaptable skill in simulation as described above, and the resulting simulation rollout is transferred to a real arm-hand robotic system with real-time dynamics. In summary, our contributions are:

blocks.en: • Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking. A goal-conditioned RL formulation in which dense reference tracking and sparse goal reaching are trained as parallel environment types under a single shared actor, so that the human prior from tracking and the coverage from goal reaching reinforce one another. The formulation requires no dense reference input at inference. • Adaptable dexterous skills. Human-like functional grasping, in-hand reorientation with finger gaiting, and dynamic behaviors like throw-and-catch, each learned from seconds of human motion and generalized to novel states and goals. The resulting adaptable skills can achieve various downstream tasks under diverse embodiments with VLM Agent planners. • Learning from real-to-sim HOI motions. A reconstruction pipeline that converts a clip of in-the-wild human video into a simulation-ready hand-object reference, outperforming existing HOI reconstruction baselines. This pipeline allows us to learn adaptable dexterous skills from human data and transfer their simulation rollouts across simulators and to the real world.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Dexterous Skill Learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 Dexterous技能学习

blocks.en:
Endowing robots with human-level, generalizable dexterity is a long-standing goal toward generalist agents that operate across diverse real-world scenarios. A large body of prior work formulates dexterous manipulation as contact-based optimization ( Liu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Yin and Abbeel, 2025 ) , synthesizing static grasps and planning motions. These approaches are largely confined to grasping and, lacking closed-loop feedback, remain brittle under disturbances. An alternative line of work collects teleoperated demonstrations for behavior cloning ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) . The resulting policies are bound to the distribution of in-domain demonstrations and generalize poorly; moreover, existing teleoperation interfaces (e.g., gloves and exoskeletons) struggle to capture behaviors that demand high dexterity or dynamic motion.
More recently, reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising route to generalizable dexterity. Task-specific methods have been developed for dexterous grasping ( Wan et al., 2023 ; Lum et al., 2024 ; Singh et al., 2025 ) and in-hand reorientation ( Qi et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , while two more general paradigms have gained traction: motion tracking ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Mandi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) and generalized goal reaching ( Kuang et al., 2026 ; Kedia et al., 2026 ) . Each paradigm exhibits a complementary limitation: motion tracking faithfully reproduces a reference but cannot generalize beyond it, whereas goal reaching handles arbitrary goals but yields motions that lack human-like functionality. Our method unifies the two so that they reinforce each other, learning adaptable dexterous skills that span functional grasping, in-hand manipulation, and dynamic behaviors from only seconds of human motion.
blocks.zh:
赋予机器人人类层面的可通俗化的分解性,是针对跨不同现实世界情景运作的通俗主义代理人的长期目标. 前作中一大批作品会形成以接触为主的刻板操控(刘等,2020;刘等,2021;王等,2022;张等,2024;殷等,2025;殷等等,2025),合成静态抓取和规划动议. 这些办法基本上限于把握,而且由于缺乏封闭式反馈,在动乱下仍然不易采用。 另一条工作线收集了用于行为克隆的远程操作演示(Wang等,2024a; Lin等,2025;Wen等,2025;徐等,2025a.). 由此产生的政策与域内演示的分布相接并被概括得很差;此外,现有的远程操作接口(如手套和外骨骼等)也难以捕捉到需要高弹性或动态运动的行为.
最近,强化学习(RL)已成为通俗易懂的通路。 已经制定了针对具体任务的方法,用于脱节取取取(Wan等,2023;Lum等,2024;Singh等,2025)和手动取向(Qi等,2023;Wang等,2024b;Liu等,2025b),同时,还有两个一般性范例:运动跟踪(Liu等,2025a; Li等,2025;Mandi等,2025;Xu等,2025b;Liang等,2026;Li等,2026;Feng等,2026;)并实现普遍目标(Kuang等,2026;Kedia等,2026)。 每个范例都表现出一个互补的局限性:运动跟踪忠实地复制了一种参考,但不能超越它而概括,而目标实现则处理任意目标而产生缺乏人性功能的运动。 我们的方法将两者统一起来,使它们相互加强, 学习适应性强的技巧 跨越功能把握, 手动操纵, 和动态行为 从人类运动的一秒。

blocks.en: 2.2 Robot Learning from Human Motion
blocks.zh: 2.2 从人类运动中学习机器人

blocks.en:
Human data constitutes the most scalable source of supervision for robot learning, and human motion in particular has been widely exploited ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ) . Motion tracking has become the dominant recipe for humanoid control and loco-manipulation ( Liao et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , and the same idea has been extended to dexterous manipulation ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2025b ; Lum et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . These methods, however, typically offer limited generalization and require a dense reference trajectory as the goal at inference time.
We are inspired by recent work on hybrid imitation learning, including HIL ( Wang et al., 2026b ) and GfR ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , which relax this requirement, enabling humanoid parkour from sparse goals while still generalizing beyond the reference. Building on this insight, our method couples motion tracking with goal reaching RL to learn dexterous skills that are simultaneously human-like and generalizable from seconds of human motion.
blocks.zh:
人类数据构成机器人学习最可扩展的监督来源,特别是人类运动被广泛利用(Wu等,2023;Ye等,2023.). 运动跟踪已成为人造物控制和loco-manapulation的主要配方(廖等,2026;罗等,2026;谢等,2026;),同样的想法被推广到自相残杀(刘等,2025a; 徐等,2025年b;卢姆等,2025年;梁等,2026年;李等,2026年;冯等,2026年. 然而,这些方法通常提供有限的概括性,在推论时需要有密集的参考轨迹作为目标。
我们受到最近关于混合仿真学习的工作的启发,包括HIL(Wang等人,2026b)和GfR(Wang等人,2026c),它们放宽了这一要求,使得人性园艺能够从零星的目标中脱颖而出,而同时又超越了参考范围。 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们的方法夫妇运动跟踪 目标到达了RL 来学习同时具有人类性能和一般性的技能 从人类运动的秒。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our goal is to turn a single human hand-object trajectory τ ^ \hat{\tau} of a few seconds into an adaptable dexterous skill that preserves the human’s manipulation strategy yet remains adaptable from novel scenarios that the reference never visited. We first formalize the problem as goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) (§ 3.1 ). We then present the core contribution, Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking , which trains one policy on two populations of parallel environments: Tracking Environments that supply human prior through dense tracking rewards (§ 3.2.1 ), and Generalization Environments that supply generalization through sparse goal-reaching rewards on noised goals (§ 3.2.2 ). Finally, we describe how our method extends to real-to-sim and sim-to-real—how the reference is reconstructed from in-the-wild human videos (§ B ) and how the simulation rollout is transferred to hardware (§ 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
blocks.zh: 3.2 混合型Dexterous模仿

blocks.en: Pure motion tracking and pure goal-reaching RL sit at opposite ends of a trade-off. Tracking a single clip ( Li et al., 2025 ; Mandi et al., 2025 ) yields human-like, dexterous motion but a policy that can only replay that clip. Goal-reaching with a sparse success reward, as in Dex4D ( Kuang et al., 2026 ) and SimToolReal ( Kedia et al., 2026 ) , generalizes to arbitrary goals but has no prior on how to move and converges to unnatural, unreliable finger strategies, and it rarely discovers behaviors such as finger gaiting on its own. Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking, inspired by hybrid imitation for humanoid control ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026c ) , obtains both by running the two settings as different environments that share one policy.

blocks.en: The policy could generalize from the reference because we can apply large noises to states and goals. With only goal reaching objective, large goal noise ( Δ p , Δ R \Delta_{\mathrm{p}},\Delta_{\mathrm{R}} ) would drive a goal reaching policy toward whatever finger strategy the optimizer finds first, which can often be unnatural. However, in our Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking, TrackEnvs continually pull the shared actor back onto the manifold of human-like behaviors, while GenEnvs ask it to stretch that manifold to new states and goals. Therefore, the policy can generalize and deviate from the reference whenever the goal calls for it, but behaves with human-like grasps, gaits, and release.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on reference motion clips over diverse objects and motions. For quantitative studies, we select 12 distinct objects from GRAB dataset ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) , with 3 distinct but similar motion clips for each object, where each object-specific policy is only trained on one of the 3 motions , and we use the other two unseen motions as the test set. We also capture 9 casual videos and reconstruct their HOI reference as in § 3.3 and § B with a RealSense D455 camera, to compare tracking performance on real-to-sim reconstructed HOI motions. Quantitative experiments are conducted on a 22-DoF Arti-Mano floating hand with 6-DoF wrist control, and we also demonstrate transfer to other robot hands and arm+hand setting in § 4.3 and § 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们在各种物体和运动上的参考运动片段的方法。 为了进行定量研究,我们从GRAB数据集(Taheri等,2020年)中选择了12个不同的对象,每个对象有3个不同但相近的运动片段,其中每个对象的特定政策只接受3个运动之一的训练,我们使用另外两个看不见的运动作为测试集. 我们还捕捉了9个临时视频,并用RealSense D455相机重建了第3.3节和B节中的HOI参考,以比较实时重建的HOI动作的跟踪性能. 22-DoF Arti-Mano浮动手和6-DoF手腕控制进行定量实验,我们还演示了第4.3和4.4节中向其他机器人手和手臂+手架的转移.

blocks.en: We compare our method with motion tracking baseline ManipTrans ( Li et al., 2025 ) and goal reaching baseline SimToolReal ( Kedia et al., 2026 ) , to demonstrate our method’s superiority on tracking accuracy and motion naturalness. For ours and ManipTrans, we train one policy per motion clip, and for SimToolReal without explicit hand tracking, we finetune on their checkpoint to train object-specific policies for each object. We also include two ablation baselines w/o TrackEnv and w/o GenEnv to verify the effectiveness of both environments in our training.
blocks.zh: 我们比较我们的方法与运动跟踪基线Maniptrans(Li等,2025年)和达到基线SimTooleReal(Kedia等,2026年)的目标,以显示我们的方法在跟踪准确性和运动自然性上的优越性。 对于我们的和ManipTrans,我们每个运动片段训练一个政策,对于SimToolReal,没有明确的手迹追踪,我们微调他们的检查站,为每个物体训练特定对象的政策. 我们还包括两个参考基线w/o TrackEnv和w/o GenEnv,以核实两个环境在我们的培训中的有效性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: In this work we present AdaDex , a framework for learning adaptable dexterous skills from seconds of human motion. At the core of AdaDex is Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking : a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning framework in which a single policy is trained simultaneously in tracking environments, which supply dense supervision from the human reference, and generalization environments, which pose noised, off-reference goals under a sparse object reward. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world verify the effectiveness of our framework, demonstrating dexterous functional grasping, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic behaviors. We further showcase our policies performing various downstream tasks with different embodiments, highlighting our recipe’s generality and adaptability. Finally, we show transfer across simulators and to the real world.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了AdaDex,这是从人类运动的几秒钟开始学习适应性能的灵活技能的框架。 AdaDex的核心是Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking:一个目标条件强化的学习框架,在这个框架中,单一的政策同时在跟踪环境方面得到训练,这种环境提供来自人类参考的密集监督,以及泛化环境,这种环境在稀有对象奖励下构成被点名的,不参考的目标. 在模拟和现实世界中的广泛实验验证了我们框架的效能,展示了自相矛盾的功能把握,手头的调整,和动态的行为. 我们进一步展示我们执行不同下游任务的政策, 最后,我们展示了跨模拟器和向现实世界的转移。

blocks.en: B.2.1 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: B.2.1 评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate on DexYCB and HO3D dataset. For DexYCB, we evaluate on the s0_test subset, using only camera sequence 836212060125 , downsampling the sequences to 10 FPS. For HO3D, we evaluate on the official evaluation set, using HO3D_v3 version, downsampling to 6 FPS.
blocks.zh: 我们对DexYCB和HO3D数据集进行评估. 对于 DexYCB,我们在s0_test子集上进行评估,只使用相机序列836212060125,将序列样本降为10个FPS. 对于HO3D,我们对官方评价集进行评估,使用HO3D_v3版本,将样本降为6个FPS.

blocks.en: Our method and Do-As-I-Do require the user to specify the target object; Do-As-I-Do additionally requires a reference frame to be selected. We therefore evaluate all methods under a common initialization protocol: the target object is specified by its ground-truth mask in frame 0, subsequent masks are propagated using SAM 2, and frame 0 is used as the object reconstruction reference. (For EgoInfinity, this replaces its automatic object identification and reconstruction-frame selection.) To ensure sufficient visibility for first-frame object reconstruction and subsequent tracking, we retain only sequences where at least 70% of the target object’s rendered silhouette is visible in the first frame. This retains only 135 sequences in DexYCB s0_test , while all sequences are kept in HO3D.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法和Do-As-I-Do需要用户指定目标对象;Do-As-I-Do还需要选择一个参考框架. 因此,我们根据共同的初始化协议来评价所有方法:目标对象由它的地真口罩在帧0中指定,随后的口罩使用SAM 2来宣传,并使用帧0作为对象重建的参考. (对于"EgoInfinity",这取代了它的自动对象识别和重建框选择. ) 为了保证第一帧物体的重建及后续跟踪有足够的能见度,我们只保留在第一帧至少可见70%的目标物体所制成的硅胶的序列. 这只保留了 DexYCB s0_test 中的135个序列,而所有序列都保存在HO3D中.

blocks.en: For Do-As-I-Do, we use the middle frame of each sampled clip as the preferred alignment reference frame and, if it is invalid, select the nearest valid frame. This avoids fixing the reference to frame 0, where the hand is often absent.
blocks.zh: 对于Do-As-I-Do,我们使用每个被采样的剪辑的中间帧作为首选的对齐参考帧,如果无效,则选择最近的有效帧. 这避免了对框 0 的引用,因为这里经常没有手.

blocks.en: We adapt both Do-As-I-Do ( Paliwal et al., 2026 ) and EgoInfinity ( Wang et al., 2026a ) to the RGB-D setting by replacing their monocular geometry estimates with the depth and camera intrinsics provided by dataset. The supplied geometry is used whenever their methods require depth or intrinsics estimation, throughout their depth-dependent reconstruction, tracking, and alignment stages, while retaining each method’s underlying estimation and alignment procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们把Do-As-I-Do(Paliwal等,2026年)和EgoInfinity(Wang等,2026a年)都适应了RGB-D设置,用数据集提供的深度和相机所固有的相机来取而代之. 只要其方法需要深度或内在估计,在深度依赖的重建、跟踪和调整阶段使用所提供的几何方法,同时保留每种方法的基本估计和调整程序。

Regarding action space, for the floating Arti-Mano setting, the action a t a_{t} consists of 6-DoF delta wrist command and 22-DoF absolute finger commmand.
We first apply a exponential moving average (EMA) filter with smoothing factor α = 0.4 \alpha=0.4 to the raw action, and then scale the action to joint ranges. For the arm, the scaled action is interpreted as delta wrist pose Δ ​ x t w \Delta x^{w}_{t} with respect to current wrist pose w t w w^{w}_{t} and converted into 6D force/torque by a PD controller, which is then applied to the floating hand base. For the finger, the scaled action is the absolute finger joint targets for the PD controller.

我们首先对原始动作采用一个有平滑系数α=0.4\alpha=0.4的指数移动平均(EMA)滤波器,然后将动作缩放到联合范围。 对于手臂,缩放的动作被解释为三角地腕姿势 → x t → Delta x^{w}_{t → 对于当前手腕姿势 → t → w^{w}_{t →由PD控制器转换为6D力/torque,然后被应用到浮手基. 对于手指,缩放的动作是PD控制器的绝对指关节目标.

blocks.en: C.2 Network Architecture and Training Details
blocks.zh: C.2 网络建筑和培训细节

blocks.en: We train the policy using PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) with asymmetric actor-critic. We initialize both actor and critic networks as MLP with hidden layers [ 1024 , 1024 , 512 ] \big[1024,1024,512\big] with ELU activations ( Clevert et al., 2015 ) . The policy action is sampled from a Gaussian distribution with learnable action std.
blocks.zh: 我们用PPO(Schulman等, 2017年)来训练政策, 我们将演员和评论家网络初始化为有隐藏层的MLP [1024, 1024, 512]\big [1024, 1024, 512\big] 有ELU活化(Clevert等, 2015). 政策行动从高斯的分布中抽取,并附有可学习的行动。

blocks.en: Our training is divided to two stages for a curriculum purpose. In stage I all parallel environments are TrackEnvs to give a good human prior for the policy, where in stage II we initialize from stage I actor checkpoint, and train under 50/50 TrackEnv and GenEnv to provide the policy with stage/goal coverage and generalization.
blocks.zh: 为了课程目的,我们的培训分为两个阶段。 在第一阶段,所有平行环境都是TrackEnvs,为政策提供良好的人先,在第二阶段,我们从第一阶段演员检查站起步,在50/50 TrackEnv和GenEnv下进行培训,为政策提供阶段/目标覆盖和概括。

blocks.en:
The policy is trained using Isaac Gym ( Makoviychuk et al., 2021 ) with 8,192 parallel environments per GPU. Each stage is trained till convergence, with a 20k-iteration hard cap. It takes around 1-2 days for each stage to converge on a single GeForce RTX 4090 GPU.

blocks.en: C.4 Curriculum and Termination
blocks.zh: C.4 课程设置和终止

blocks.en: For curriculum design, except the GenEnv ramping up curriculum mentioned in § C.2 , we also adopt a gravity and friction curriculum similar to Li et al. (2025) , where at stage I early training stage, the gravity is small and friction is high to make tracking easier. As training progresses, the tracking difficulty gradually goes up and gravity and friction values go back to normal values.
blocks.zh: 对于课程设计,除了§C.2中提及的GenEnv提升课程外,我们还采用了与李等相类似的重力和摩擦课程(2025年),在第一阶段的早期训练阶段,重力很小,摩擦也很高以方便跟踪. 随着训练的进行,追踪困难逐渐上升,重力和摩擦值又回到了正常值.

blocks.en: For early termination, for TrackEnvs, it’s a standard tracking-based termination design which forces the policy to keep close to the reference. We also have a termination curriculum where termination thresholds are divided by a scaling factor 0.7, which gradually goes to 1.0 through time to make termination tighter ( Li et al., 2025 ) . For GenEnvs, episodes are early terminated when no goal reached for 30 consecutive steps (0.5 s), object position more than 50 cm from sampled goal (after the initial 8-step grace period), or wrist more than 30 cm from object for 3 s.
blocks.zh: 对于早期终止,对于TrackEnvs来说,它是一种标准的跟踪式终止设计,它迫使政策接近参考. 我们还制定了终止课程,将终止阈值除以缩放系数0.7,该系数逐渐达到1.0,以缩短终止时间(Li等,2025年)。 对于GenEnvs来说,当连续30个步骤(0.5 s)没有达到入球,对象位置从被取出的目标(在最初的8步宽限期后)到被取出的目标超过50厘米,或者从对象手腕到被取出的目标超过30厘米时,事件会提前终止.

blocks.en: Appendix D Kinematic Motion Retargeting
blocks.zh: 附 录 D 移动重定向

blocks.en: Inspired by Yang et al. (2025) ; Feng et al. (2026) , we adopt a interaction mesh-based kinematic retargeting method to turn the MANO ( Romero et al., 2022 ) parameters into embodiment-specific joint positions and wrist pose. Note that the retargeted joint positions are only used for reference state initialization. The tracking reward, termination, etc., all depend on raw MANO links from the HOI reference τ ^ \hat{\tau} , where each embodiment maintains a one-to-one MANO-to-robot mapping based on its kinematic structure.
blocks.zh: 受杨等(2025年);冯等(2026年)的启发,我们采用了基于相互作用的网状活性重定向方法,将MANO(Romero等,2022年)参数转化为特有的同位素相位和腕相. 请注意,重新确定目标的联合位置只用于参考状态初始化。 追踪奖励,终止等,都取决于HOI参考 \\ hat\tau}的原始MANO链接,其中每个化身都根据其运动结构保持一对一的MANO对机器人映射.

blocks.en: Appendix F Baseline Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 细节

blocks.en: In this work, we compare our method with representative baselines from motion tracking and general goal reaching methodologies. We compare with ManipTrans ( Li et al., 2025 ) for motion tracking baseline and SimToolReal ( Kedia et al., 2026 ) for goal reaching baseline. We also compare with two ablation baselines w/o TrackEnv and w/o GenEnv to show necessity and synergy between the two sets of environments.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们将我们的方法与运动跟踪和一般目标达到方法的具有代表性的基线进行比较。 我们比较了运动跟踪基线的Maniptrans(Li等,2025年)和达到基线的SimToolReal(Kedia等,2026年)。 我们还与TorkEnv和w/o GenEnv的两个基准进行比较,以显示这两组环境的必要性和协同作用。

blocks.en: For ManipTrans, we utilize their pretrained first-stage imitator checkpoint and learn a residual policy for each trajectory, aligned with our observation and action space. For SimToolReal, we use their original Kuka+Sharpa embodiment, and finetune their pretrained checkpoint to train object-specific policies for each object. Note that due to different interfaces of the baselines and our method, for tracking seen and similar motions, we only give object goal poses for SimToolReal, while for goal reaching, we give ManipTrans hand references from contact frames where candidate frames are restricted to frames at/after the handoff where at least two fingertips are within 4 cm of the object. For each trajectory, the candidate with the lowest deterministic contact cost is selected. Therefore, the random goal gets a plausible, source-recorded grasp configuration that is transported with the object.
blocks.zh: 对ManipTrans来说,我们利用他们经过预先训练的第一阶段仿真检查站,并学习与我们的观察和行动空间相一致的每个轨道的剩余政策。 对SimToolReal来说,我们使用他们最初的Kuka+Sharpa的化身,并微调他们经过事先训练的检查站,为每个对象训练特定对象的政策. 注意,由于基线和我们的方法的界面不同,为了跟踪所见及相类似的运动,我们只给SimToolReal设定对象目标,而为了达到目标,我们从联系框中给出ManipTrans手取参考,在交接时/交接后,候选框被限制在交接时/交接后,至少有两个指尖位于对象相距4厘米以内. 对于每一轨迹,选择确定接触费用最低的候选人。 因此,随机目标得到一种与对象一起运输的可信,有源记录的抓取配置.

blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our method currently learns one policy per object and per reference trajectory. Scaling to a single policy that covers many objects and motions is a natural next step, and would also enable skill composition across tasks. In addition, we represent object state as a 6-DoF pose plus a BPS shape code, chosen as a minimal recipe. Adopting a point track representation as in Dex4D ( Kuang et al., 2026 ) would unlock manipulating objects with more complex geometry, such as articulated or deformable objects.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法目前每个对象和每个参考轨迹学习一个政策。 扩大一项涵盖许多目标和动议的单一政策,是下一个自然步骤,也将促进各种任务的技能构成。 此外,我们代表对象状态作为6-DoF的外形外加BPS形状代码,被选作最低配方. 采用Dex4D(Kuang等,2026年)中的点轨表示法,可以解锁有更复杂的几何形状的操纵物体,如被拼接或可变形物体等.
